_note: Declared benchmark gate failures. A metric below its threshold is never silently marked PASS; it must be listed here with a reason, and the report text must state FAIL for it. Resolved failures are moved to resolved_failures with root cause, fix and the measured passing value — history is preserved, never rewritten.

resolved_failures.resolved_in_commit: see git log for this commit
resolved_failures.root_cause: Round-2 的三条主推荐里有一条（全国大学生智能汽车竞赛，smartcarrace.com）只有 verification_status=verified_official，却没有 evidence.application_status 结构；当时的 gate 不检查该结构，于是这条被算作『已核实』进入主推荐，把最终验证率压到 67%。
resolved_failures.fix: 主推荐 gate 现在要求 canonical source + verified_official + 带日期的 application-status 证据（scripts/evidence.py 的前置检查）；缺结构的机会一律降级到 worth_verifying，不计入『已核实』。配套的 source_freshness 还会拒绝把历史页面当作当前证据。
resolved_failures.measured_by: benchmarks/runs/iot-embedded/record-si.json — 2026-09-20 真实联网重跑：4/4 主推荐均带当日官方 evidence（source_url + verified_at）
